result.description: Northwind Aurora is a fictional 27-inch OLED gaming monitor designed for high-refresh desktop setups. It features a 2560 x 1440 QHD panel, 240Hz refresh rate, 0.03ms response time, and DisplayHDR 400 support. Connectivity includes 2x HDMI 2.1, 1x DisplayPort 1.4, and a USB-C input with 65W power delivery. The display also offers adjustable height, tilt, swivel, and pivot ergonomics, plus a matte anti-glare coating.
